headline: Low Tail, extreme weekend Stress; Sunday Globex reopening remains the key conditional window
body: NQ is closed. Warsh-driven rate repricing is still visible in Sunday Gulf equities, while fresh shared Finviz context shows weak latest-session semiconductors against mixed-positive megacaps. These are supporting signals, not live NQ price-path evidence. Tail therefore remains low until the reopening tests gap persistence and retracement quality.

lookbackSummary: From Aug. 29 14:00 UTC through Aug. 30 13:00 UTC, published ChatGPT assessments kept Tail at 19% in normal mode. Stress rose from 76% to 80% as weekend reopening risk accumulated; confidence stayed 94-96%.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low while NQ is closed, then Stress rises into the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen. The first three reopening hours are conditional WATCH; meaningful retracement and two-sided discovery would support a return below WATCH, while repeated extension and extreme-holding would invalidate that baseline.
